description.value: The target stops having been there. It is not destroyed — the space simply reads as empty, and always did. Anything resting on it falls. Signal up to 20 feet on a side.

target.value: 1 unattended object or structure up to 10 feet on a side

cinderfall.incomplete: Target unattended object/structure up to 10 ft/side stops existing (Signal: up to 20 ft/side). The area-size increase gates a targeting restriction (what the spell may legally target), not a roll modifier; `ItemAlteration`'s `area-size` property exists but is meant for permanent item-level alterations (e.g. heightened scrolls), not a per-cast conditional relaxation of a target-size cap -- no clean predicate-gated mechanism found for this specific shape.
